notes: An MVV day ticket costs about 9 EUR; the S-Bahn to the airport takes 40 minutes. For Neuschwanstein, take the Bayern-Ticket (train and bus) or a tour.
In December there are Christmas markets (Marienplatz, Tollwood); in winter it is around 0°C with snow. The Alps and Neuschwanstein are under snow, and the beer halls are warm.
A Mass of beer costs 15 EUR (16+ at Oktoberfest), Brezn 2 EUR, Schweinshaxe 20 EUR; you can bring your own food to a beer garden. When tipping, round up the bill.
Eat Weisswurst before noon and peel off the skin; it comes with sweet mustard.
Museums cost 1 EUR on Sundays (the Pinakothek galleries); book Neuschwanstein tickets online weeks ahead.
The Dachau memorial is free and open on Mondays; please stay quiet and respectful.

stops.name: Marienplatz
stops.tips: Glockenspiel at 11:00 (and 12:00, plus 17:00 in summer); the Neues Rathaus tower lift costs 6 EUR.

stops.name: Frauenkirche
stops.tips: Cathedral with twin onion-domed towers; look for the Devil's Footprint.

stops.name: Viktualienmarkt
stops.tips: Food market since 1807; try Weisswurst (tradition says eat it before noon), Obazda and the beer garden.

stops.name: Asamkirche
stops.tips: Rococo church on Sendlinger Strasse.

stops.name: Hofbräuhaus München
stops.tips: Beer hall dating from 1589; Mass of beer, Schweinshaxe (roast pork knuckle) and a brass band, sharing long tables with locals.

backups.name: Augustiner Bräustuben
backups.tips: The brewery's own hall; a local alternative to the Hofbräuhaus.

backups.name: Peterskirche Alter Peter Tower
backups.tips: 306 steps up; views over Marienplatz, an alternative to the Frauenkirche.

stops.name: Munich Residenz
stops.tips: Wittelsbach palace; see the Antiquarium, the treasury and the Cuvilliés Theatre.

stops.name: Hofgarten
stops.tips: Palace garden with a Diana temple.

stops.name: Eisbachwelle
stops.tips: River-wave surfers in the middle of the city, all year round.

stops.name: Chinesischer Turm Biergarten
stops.tips: Beer garden by the Chinese pagoda in the Englischer Garten; you can bring your own food. Try Brezn (pretzel) and Steckerlfisch (grilled fish on a stick).

stops.name: Englischer Garten Monopteros
stops.tips: A winter walk; the Seehaus on the lakeshore and the park under snow.

backups.name: Alte Pinakothek
backups.tips: Dürer, Rubens, Rembrandt; 1 EUR on Sundays, a good swap for the park when it rains.

stops.name: Nymphenburg Palace
stops.tips: Baroque summer palace; see the Gallery of Beauties and the Amalienburg. The park is free.

stops.name: Nymphenburg Palace Park
stops.tips: Canals and pavilions, with swans.

stops.name: Schlosscafé im Palmenhaus
stops.tips: Greenhouse café; lunch in the palace park.

stops.name: Olympiapark
stops.tips: The tent roofs of the 1972 Olympics; the Olympiaturm viewing platform costs 13 EUR.

stops.name: BMW Welt and Museum
stops.tips: BMW Welt is free, the museum costs 10 EUR; next to Olympiapark.

backups.name: Pinakothek der Moderne
backups.tips: Modern art and design; an alternative to BMW.

stops.name: Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial
stops.tips: 45 minutes by S2 and bus; memorial at the first concentration camp. Free entry, audio guide 4 EUR. Heavy but necessary.

stops.name: Dachau Altstadt
stops.tips: The town's old quarter and palace garden; a quiet break.

stops.name: Schwabing Leopoldstrasse
stops.tips: Bohemian district with the Siegestor and cafés.

stops.name: Café Luitpold
stops.tips: Coffee house from 1888; try the Prinzregententorte (layered chocolate cake).

stops.name: Glockenbachviertel
stops.tips: LGBTQ+-friendly neighbourhood with bars and Gärtnerplatz.

backups.name: Bratwurstherzl Viktualienmarkt
backups.tips: Nuremberg sausages next to the market.

backups.name: Lenbachhaus
backups.tips: Blaue Reiter (Kandinsky, Marc); an alternative to Schwabing.

stops.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
stops.tips: 2.5 hours by train and bus (Bayern-Ticket) or on a tour. Ludwig's fairy-tale castle; book timed tickets online weeks ahead. The climb takes 30 minutes.

stops.name: Marienbrücke
stops.tips: The bridge with the postcard view of the castle; it may be closed in winter because of ice.

stops.name: Hohenschwangau Castle
stops.tips: Ludwig's childhood castle; combined ticket available.

stops.name: Alpsee Lake Walk
stops.tips: Mountain lake below the castles, with swans.

stops.name: Füssen Altstadt
stops.tips: Medieval town; have Käsespätzle (cheese noodles) before the train back.

backups.name: Tegelbergbahn
backups.tips: Cable car to an Alpine summit; an alternative to the lake.

stops.name: Deutsches Museum
stops.tips: The world's largest science museum; mining, aircraft and a planetarium.

stops.name: Isar River Walk
stops.tips: A winter walk along the river.

stops.name: Wirtshaus in der Au
stops.tips: Bavarian restaurant specialising in Knödel (dumplings); in the Au district.

stops.name: Müllersches Volksbad
stops.tips: Art nouveau swimming pool from 1901, with a sauna.

stops.name: Gärtnerplatz
stops.tips: Round square and theatre; come in the evening.

backups.name: Der Pschorr Viktualienmarkt
backups.tips: Bavarian food at the edge of the market.

backups.name: Deutsches Museum Verkehrszentrum
backups.tips: Transport museum; an alternative to the baths.

stops.name: Theresienwiese & Bavaria Statue
stops.tips: Oktoberfest grounds (September–October); views from the head of the Bavaria statue.

stops.name: Augustiner-Keller Biergarten
stops.tips: Chestnut-shaded beer garden seating 5,000; a Mass and Brezn for your farewell.

stops.name: Munich Hauptbahnhof
stops.tips: S-Bahn to the airport takes 40 minutes; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Marienplatz Dallmayr
backups.tips: Luxury delicatessen and café; good for souvenirs.

backups.name: Alter Botanischer Garten
backups.tips: Park next to the station; an alternative to Theresienwiese.
